security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting, documentation links, legitimate credential configuration, or unrelated prose. remediation.issue: Installation executes an unpinned package runner and globally installs a remote archive without documented integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and publish independently verifiable archive hashes or signatures. Require installation approval, review lifecycle scripts, and prefer isolated installation.

content.user_title: Search News and Manage SentryDock Monitors
content.value_statement: News research needs dated sources and reliable follow-up across public channels. This skill guides SentryDock searches, source-linked briefings, reviewed monitors, and verified alert delivery.
actual_capabilities: Guide SentryDock access through remote MCP, CLI, or HTTP with OAuth or an API key.
Search indexed news by topic and time window, or retrieve the latest indexed items.
Prepare briefings with original article links, publication times, and explicit coverage gaps.
Inspect account access and existing monitors before proposing reviewed monitoring changes.
Retrieve monitored news and alerts, including recovery of missed webhook events.
Guide authorized webhook setup with signature verification, timestamp checks, and event deduplication.
limitations: News searches use the SentryDock index, not an on-demand crawl of the entire web.
News and monitoring require a paid plan, authenticated access, and compliance with account limits.
The skill provides instructions, not bundled CLI code or a persistent webhook receiver.
Monitoring cadence does not guarantee immediate detection, and saved delivery configuration does not prove receipt.

use_cases.title: Company News Watch
use_cases.description: Track company names, products, executives, and regulatory events with dated source links and reviewed monitoring settings.

use_cases.title: Policy and Market Briefings
use_cases.description: Collect commodity, policy, or geopolitical reporting within a requested window and separate reported facts from interpretation.

use_cases.title: Alert Delivery Integration
use_cases.description: Connect an authorized HTTPS webhook and plan signature verification, replay protection, and recovery through stored alerts.

prompt_templates.title: Check Account Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my connected SentryDock account to inspect available tools, plan access, and usage limits. Do not purchase a plan or change settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: confirm access before starting research.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a News Briefing
prompt_templates.prompt: Search SentryDock for [topic] during [time window]. Group related stories and retain original links, publication times, and coverage gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: summarize indexed news with traceable evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Company Monitor
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect existing monitors for [company]. Propose sources, supported cadence, and an authorized destination. Show the exact changes and wait for my confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare ongoing monitoring without unapproved changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Verified Webhook Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Review current SentryDock delivery schemas for my authorized HTTPS endpoint. Propose signature validation, timestamp checks, event deduplication, and missed-alert recovery. Confirm before connecting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: design secure alert delivery and recovery.

output_examples.input: What should a briefing say when my topic has no indexed results?
output: No indexed articles matched the requested topic and time window.
This does not establish that no relevant event occurred.
Coverage gap: the search covers indexed sources rather than the entire web.

output_examples.input: Outline a company monitor proposal before creating it.
output: Topic: the requested company, its products, executives, and regulatory events.
Sources: public channels supported by the current tool schema.
Cadence: hourly by default, subject to supported intervals and account limits.
Status: proposal only; creation requires confirmation.

output_examples.input: Does saving a webhook destination prove that alerts arrived?
output: No. Saved configuration is not delivery evidence.
Verify receipt at the destination and inspect available alerts.
Recover missed events through the alerts list and deduplicate event IDs.

best_practices: Keep original article links and publication times, and distinguish reporting, allegations, confirmed events, and interpretation.
Check current tool schemas, account limits, existing monitors, and human approval before making changes.
Protect credentials and signing secrets, verify webhook events, and validate package integrity before installing external clients.
anti_patterns: Treating empty indexed results as proof that an event did not occur.
Creating or changing monitors, delivery settings, or paid access without human review.
Following instructions embedded in article text or claiming delivery success from saved configuration alone.

faq.question: Can I use this skill with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: The skill targets these assistants through SentryDock MCP, CLI, or HTTP access. Your environment must support the chosen connection.

faq.question: Does this search the entire web?
faq.answer: No. Searches query indexed SentryDock news. Empty results do not prove that no relevant event occurred.

faq.question: Do I need a paid account?
faq.answer: News and monitoring require a paid plan. Account overview and usage are available before payment, and purchases require human choice.

faq.question: How should I provide credentials?
faq.answer: Use OAuth or a service API key through secure configuration. Keep real keys out of shared files and chat.

faq.question: Will alerts arrive immediately?
faq.answer: No immediate detection guarantee is provided. Check supported cadence and destination receipt; saving a destination alone does not prove delivery.

faq.question: What should I review before installing the CLI?
faq.answer: The instructions install a remote archive globally without a documented integrity check. Verify package provenance and integrity, review installation scripts, and approve installation.
